snp5.3:0.2: The Young Man Tissa Metteyya’s Questions
snp5.3:1.2: “Who is satisfied here in the world? said venerable Tissa Metteyya,
snp5.3:1.3: For whom is there no turmoil?
snp5.3:1.5: Who is the wise man, who has known both ends, and is undefiled in the middle?
snp5.3:1.6: Who do you say is a Great Man? Who has gone beyond the seamstress here?”
snp5.3:2.1: “He who is chaste in regard to sense pleasures, Metteyya, said the Fortunate One,
snp5.3:2.4: having discernment the monk is emancipated, for him there is no turmoil.
snp5.3:3.2: He is the wise man, who has known both ends, and is undefiled in the middle.
snp5.3:3.3: He, I say, is a Great Man, he has gone beyond the seamstress here.”
